title: Double Drip Lemon Sherbet 50/50 E-Liquid
description: If you have a sweet-tooth with a taste for the nostalgic, you’ll simply love Double Drip’s Lemon Sherbet which perfectly captures everyone’s favourite tuck shop classic in an irresistibly delicious e-liquid. Bright, zesty lemons deliver a rush of citrus flavour on the inhale, followed by the tangy hit of tongue-tingling sherbet on the exhale. Sweet, sharp, punchy and endlessly refreshing, Lemon Sherbet from Double Drip is bursting with flavour and satisfaction. Double Drip Coil Sauce E-Liquid is a high-quality vape juice brand proudly manufactured right here in the United Kingdom. Browse the entire Double Drip range and find the perfect juice for your e-cigarette setup. Double Drip is available in a variety of formulations to suit a range of kits, including sub ohm (high-VG), 50/50 e-liquid , nicotine salt vape juice , and 50ml shortfills for use with starter vape kits , high-powered e cig kits, compact pod vape kits and pen vape kits .
